cap: The follicle grows around an oocyte that is paused, not dividing. The primary oocyte waits in prophase I from fetal life until the LH surge of its own cycle, then finishes meiosis I and pauses again in metaphase II. Ovulation releases that secondary oocyte; meiosis II finishes only at fertilization. The follicle wall becomes the corpus luteum and, without pregnancy, the corpus albicans.
